pool: frozen r66-eight-plans-v1; held fixed across network controls
ablation_scope: Explicit scoring columns only. Raw history remains. All controls retain heuristic-generated candidate pool. No-score-inputs retains x13 skip; no-score-or-skip removes that additional path separately.
batch: full labelled state batch if memory permits; same updates for all controls
output_initialization: zero final weights and bias; same initial zero residual
loss: R70 Huber + 0.25 normalized-gap-weighted pair softplus, pair temperature0.25; equal informative-case weights; missing/padding/ties excluded as documented
precision: FP32 training; disable CUDA TF32 and AMP; deterministic seed/settings recorded
device: cuda required for the actual training experiment; CPU allowed only in small contract tests and deployment reference
timing_priority: Quality first; record training wall time, parameters, MACs and later CPU D without assuming original tiny timing budget
data_gate: No actual training before complete teacher pilot quality review, explicit train-only identity checks and training resource coordination
model_selection: Compare fixed final epoch of all four on explicit dev labels and full Python rollouts; no holdout access or retroactive hyperparameter search
label_normalization_limit: Per-state normalized losses do not measure absolute microsecond improvements; report absolute regret and complete rollout G separately
